integrity_statement: The theorem is proved by integer recurrences and power inequalities; the executable finite checks are supplementary and establish no infinite assertion. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized positive integer Galileo sequences with integer \(k\ge2\); no classification of intermediate attainable partial sums, no assumption of monotone individual terms, and no claim that the digit map itself is new. Older foundational papers could not be compared throughout their full text.
title: Sharp digit envelopes and oscillation constants for positive Galileo sequences
